Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — QuantumForge is ready to move forward with Redwood for inference on our customer-facing feature. Procurement asked me to pull together the onboarding checklist so we can get a PO and activate the account. Can you confirm the documents we need to share to satisfy the procurement/security gate? I attached our vendor intake form to this message (QuantumForge_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — we'll need the exact billing name and remit address for the PO. Also let me know if Redwood requires a signed DPA or an executed master services agreement before we issue a PO.

Appreciate a quick checklist and the expected timeline.

Best,
Sara Nguyen\Procurement Operations\QuantumForge

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-14T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation steps & required privacy/security docs

Sara — thanks, and great to hear from you. Short checklist and next steps below.

Required items for procurement gate (minimal path to activation):
- Signed DPA (we support DocuSign for execution).
- SOC 2 Type II report (we'll provide a hosted link and temporary access token if required).
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV or PDF).
- Completed vendor intake (you already sent — thanks).
- PO referencing Redwood quote ID PF-9872 (we'll confirm billing details).

What I'll send you this afternoon:
1) A DocuSign link for our standard DPA (no unusual redlines required for standard PO-sized deals).
2) Hosted SOC 2 link and subprocessor list snapshot.
3) A short form for billing remit details we can confirm against your onboarding PDF.

If your legal needs to redline, please return a PDF of the redline; our counsel will review and typically responds within 48 hours. For PO routing: Laura Bennett (cc'd) handles vendor finance setup — Laura, can you confirm Redwood's required PO fields so Sara can share?

Marcus
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Sara / Marcus —

PO / vendor setup checklist from Finance:
1) Billing name (legal entity) and remit address.
2) W-9 or W-8 (for US/non-US tax) if applicable.
3) Vendor banking details for ACH (if they request electronic payment).
4) The PO should reference Redwood quote ID PF-9872 and include the billing contact name & email.

Provisioning policy: We can provision sandbox/test capacity once the DPA is signed and a PO number is in-process (a screen shot of the issued PO or provisional PO number is fine). Full production access requires the completed vendor setup in our finance system (usually within 48 hours of PO issue).

If you prefer, I can send a short vendor-setup form (one page) that you can return and I'll submit the vendor record. Laura
